name: Lavalink
author: pterodactyl@stan1712.com
description: Lavalink is a standalone audio sending node based on Lavaplayer and JDA-Audio. It allows bots to play music without the audio being processed by the bot itself, reducing resource usage significantly.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

cd /mnt/server

LAVALINK_VERSION="${LAVALINK_VERSION:-latest}"

echo "Downloading Lavalink version: ${LAVALINK_VERSION}"

if [ "${LAVALINK_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/lavalink-devs/Lavalink/releases/latest/download/Lavalink.jar"
else
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/lavalink-devs/Lavalink/releases/download/v${LAVALINK_VERSION}/Lavalink.jar"
fi

echo "Downloading from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
curl -L -o Lavalink.jar "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Failed to download Lavalink.jar"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Download complete! Size: $(du -sh Lavalink.jar)"

# Create default application.yml only if it doesn't exist
if [ ! -f application.yml ]; then
    echo "Creating default application.yml..."
    cat > application.yml << 'YAML_EOF'
server:
  port: 2333
  address: 0.0.0.0
  http2:
    enabled: false

plugins:

lavalink:
  plugins:
  server:
    password: "youshallnotpass"
    sources:
      youtube: false
      bandcamp: true
      soundcloud: true
      twitch: true
      vimeo: true
      nico: true
      http: true
      local: false
    filters:
      volume: true
      equalizer: true
      karaoke: true
      timescale: true
      tremolo: true
      vibrato: true
      distortion: true
      rotation: true
      channelMix: true
      lowPass: true
    bufferDurationMs: 400
    frameBufferDurationMs: 5000
    opusEncodingQuality: 10
    resamplingQuality: LOW
    trackStuckThresholdMs: 10000
    useSeekGhosting: true
    youtubePlaylistLoadLimit: 6
    playerUpdateInterval: 5
    youtubeSearchEnabled: true
    soundcloudSearchEnabled: true
    gc-warnings: true

metrics:
  prometheus:
    enabled: false
    endpoint: /metrics

sentry:
  dsn: ""
  environment: ""

logging:
  file:
    path: ./logs/
  level:
    root: INFO
    lavalink: INFO
  request:
    enabled: true
    includeClientInfo: true
    includeHeaders: false
    includeQueryString: true
    includePayload: true
    maxPayloadLength: 10000
  logback:
    rollingpolicy:
      max-file-size: 1GB
      max-history: 30
YAML_EOF
    echo "application.yml created successfully."
else
    echo "application.yml already exists, skipping creation."
fi

echo "Installation complete!"

variables.description: Version of Lavalink to download. Use 'latest' for the most recent stable release, or specify a version like '4.0.8'.

variables.description: Password used to authenticate connections to the Lavalink server. Change this from the default for security.
